data: TensorFlow is an open-source deep learning framework developed by Google Brain Team.
It is widely used for machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) applications.
Core concept: Tensor (multi-dimensional data array) + Flow (computations through data flow graphs).
Ease of Use – High-level Keras API for quick prototyping.
Flexibility – Works for deep learning, reinforcement learning, NLP, computer vision, etc.
Cross-Platform – Runs on CPUs, GPUs, TPUs, and even mobile devices.
Visualization – TensorBoard helps visualize model performance.
Scalability – Can handle large datasets and distributed training.
Computer Vision → image classification, object detection.
Natural Language Processing (NLP) → sentiment analysis, chatbots.
